//: What the class file cannot say. Same format as the nullability and keeps overrides for any jar.

nullability.//: `name()` is unannotated but never returns null. Without this the generator defaults it to `string | null`, which is correct-but-verbose.

keeps.//: Which parameters the callee retains. An absent entry means `assume everything`, which is always sound. `[]` means the callee keeps nothing, which lets the argument stay off the heap.
